en.headline: More than 50 companies have re-domiciled to Hong Kong, Hui says
en.dek: The Financial Services and the Treasury Secretary said over 30 applications are still being processed since the regime took effect in May 2025, providing a clear path for overseas funds.
body: More than 50 companies have completed re-domiciliation to Hong Kong since the regime took effect in May last year, with over 30 applications still under processing, Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury Christopher Hui said on Wednesday.

Speaking at the launch of platform and agent services on the Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing's integrated fund platform, Hui noted that the regime offers a clear path for overseas funds to establish a presence in the city. He also highlighted that more than 790 open-ended fund companies and over 2,000 limited partnership funds have been registered since those structures were introduced.

Hui said the government would continue to work closely with Hong Kong Exchanges, the Securities and Futures Commission and the industry to ensure the fund platform benefits managers, distributors and investors. He expressed confidence that Hong Kong would further consolidate its position as a leading global cross-border wealth management centre.

He added that connectivity with the mainland remains a core advantage, citing improvements to mutual recognition of funds, plans to include real estate investment trusts in Stock Connect, and the development of Wealth Management Connect.

zh.headline: 許正宇：已促成逾50間公司遷冊來港 正處理逾30宗申請
zh.dek: 財經事務及庫務局局長指，自去年5月制度落實後成效顯著，為海外基金落戶香港提供清晰路徑。
body: 財經事務及庫務局局長許正宇周三表示，自去年5月公司遷冊制度落實以來，已促成超過50間公司遷來香港，目前正處理超過30宗申請。
許正宇在港交所綜合基金平台推出平台及代理人服務啟動儀式上致辭時指出，有關制度為海外基金落戶香港提供清晰路徑。他又提到，自2018年及2020年分別推出開放式基金型公司及有限合夥基金制度以來，註冊OFC已超過790間，LPF超過2000間。
他表示，未來會繼續與港交所、證監會及業界緊密合作，確保綜合基金平台為基金經理、分銷商及投資者帶來效益，有信心香港將進一步鞏固作為全球領先跨境財富管理中心的地位。
許正宇強調，與內地互聯互通仍是核心優勢，完善基金互認、未來將房託基金納入滬深港通及理財通發展等，均有助擴闊資金與產品流通渠道。
